
{{alias}}( dtype, defaultValue, isValidScalar )
    Returns a function for creating zero-dimensional ndarrays.

    Parameters
    ----------
    dtype: string|DataType
        Data type.

    defaultValue: number|Complex
        Default scalar value.

    isValidScalar: Function
        Function for checking whether a value is a valid scalar value.

    Returns
    -------
    ctor: Function
        Function for creating zero-dimensional ndarrays.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias:@stdlib/constants/complex128/zero}};
    > var isValid = {{alias:@stdlib/assert/is-number-or-complex-like}}.isPrimitive;
    > var f = {{alias}}( 'complex128', v, isValid )
    <Function>
    > var arr = f()
    <ndarray>[ <Complex128>[ 0.0, 0.0 ] ]

    See Also
    --------
